title: Training-Free Time Series Classification via In-Context Reasoning with LLM Agents

claim.summary: FETA performs training-free classification through channel selection, DTW exemplar retrieval, channel-wise LLM reasoning and confidence-weighted aggregation.

modules.name: Exemplar-grounded channel classification and fusion
modules.scope_reason: Channel pruning uses class separation and nearest-neighbor accuracy; aggregation outputs class labels.
